mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing overcast skies at Verona Community Park under a waxing crescent moon. The ISS passes overhead tonight, but you won't be able to see it due to the clouds.
The Verona Police Department released a summary of calls from October 5 through October 12, highlighting several vehicle accidents and an arrest in the 100 block of Prairie Oaks Drive.
It is a busy day in Verona today with the Downtown Farmer's Market, Yoga at Insight Wellness, and Trivia Night events happening at both The Mill and The Bogey Factory.
On October 7, an incident occurred where a seventeen year old riding an electric motorcycle collided with a vehicle that was making a left turn.
Today's flavor of the day is Dark Chocolate Decadence. Culver's opens today at 10:00 AM, so be sure to stop by and enjoy a scoop.
